mods.abstract: Instruments belonged to Henry Moss Bentley, member of the UVA School of Medicine Class of 1831. Set includes: amputating tenaculum, Hey's saw, ligature needle, catling, amputating knife, catling, probe, tonsilotome, small crown trephine with handle, large crown trephine with handle, trepanning elevator, capital saw, bow saw, 2 tourniquets, clamp, folding tongue depressor, and handle.
